name: Kono Yo wa Machigatteiru no da.vdo
original_name: この世は間違っているのだ.vdo
source:
A heart-full story game based on the computer virus etc threat program <malware>

Edit the activities of the secret invading army [Gekidan Hoshiebi] and post ♡ See ♡!
What is recorded in the editing video is amazingly unique members. How does the daily drama of the electronic people who laugh, cry and struggle through the browser look to you?

→ play (you) = viewer

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/5285]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
一款以计算机病毒等威胁程序——“恶意软件”为题材的温情故事游戏。

剪辑秘密侵略军“星虾剧团”的活动影像，发布给大家♡看看♡吧！
待剪辑的视频里，记录着一群个性鲜明得惊人的团员。透过浏览器，这些电子生命欢笑、落泪、纠结的日常，在作为观众的你眼中，会是什么模样？

→玩家（你）＝观众
